tei:div.tei:p: (nya)༄༅// khyung khra'i sgrub thabs las tshogs rjes gnang dang bcas pa bzhugs so// ༄༅// gu ru badzra ga ru ḍā ya na mā mi/ 'dir mkha' lding ye shes khyung khra bsgrub par 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor pas stan bde bar 'dug ste/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi bsgom pa sngon du btang nas/ swa bhā was stong zhing bdag med par gyur/ de'i ngang las pam̐ las padma ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du phu:yongs su gyur pa las klu chen po brgyad kyi ngo bo sbrul sna tshogs kyi gdengs ka dang bcas pa'i gdan gyi steng du/ yi ge khroṃ kha dog lnga'i mdangs dang ldan pa zhig tu gyur/ de las 'od zer 'phros sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid ye shes kyi khyung khra zhal gcig phyag gnyis tsog pu 'gying bag dang ldan pas bzhugs pa'i brla gnyis man chad sa'i rang bzhin ser po/ lto ba chu'i rang bzhin dkar po/ stod me'i rang bzhin dmar po/ mgo bo rlung gi rang bzhin sngon po/ spyi bo dang rdo rje'i 'dab gshog nam mkha'i rang bzhin kha dog sna tshogs pa/ rwa dang mchu sder rno ba/ dmar la 'khrugs pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas pas klu'i rgyal po'i gtsug nas yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che phrogs te rwa g.yas phyogs kyi nam mkhar bzhag nas sgrub pa po la dngos grub ster zhing skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ phyag g.yon gdug pa can tshar gcod cing sreg par mdzad pa'i sdigs mdzub thugs kar 'dzin pa/ rin po che dang sbrul gyi rgyan rnams kyis spras shing*/ sku tshad ri rab lta bu'i ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas 'od zer 'phro ba ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par bsam/ de'i mgrin pa'i nang gi pad zla'i gdan gyi steng du/ dbus su sangs rgyas kyi bya khyung dkar po/ shar du rdo rje'i bya khyung sngon po/ lhor rin po che'i bya khyung ser po/

nub tu padma'i bya khyung dmar po/ byang du las kyi bya khyung ljang gu thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas pas rang rang gi phyag mtshan nam 'khar 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon pas rang mdog dang mthun pa'i sbrul bzung nas zhal du gsol zhing sdigs mdzub thugs kar mdzad nas zhal nang du phyogs par bzhugs pa/ gtso bo'i thugs kar pad zla'i steng du dbus su oṃ dkar po/ shar du baṃ sngon po/ lhor kṣiṃ ser po/ nub tu swā dmar po/ byang du hā ljang gu chos skor du bzhengs pa/ khyung gtso bo dang mgrin pa'i khyung lnga'i gnas gsum du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ bkod pa las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas ye shes pa badzra ga ru ḍa sa pa ri wā ra sogs kyis spyan drangs la/ arghaṃ nas shabda'i bar gyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par bstim/ bskyed rim brtan pa'i ngang nas bzlas pa bya'o// oṃ pakṣiṃ swā hā/ zhes ci nus bzlas/ thun 'jog khar rnam lngas mchod/ bstod pa 'og nas 'byung bas bstod/ 'dod don gsol/ dge ba bsngo/ bstod pa bsdus pa ni/ 'byung lnga'i rang bzhin 'byung chen lnga la dbang*// kun tu sgyur byed 'od lnga'i 'dab gshog can// klu yi dpal 'phrog mi yi dpal gyur pa'i// rdo rje nam mkha' lding la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces sngags 'chang gzungs kyi dpal bas mdzad/ gtor ma byed na/ dkar gsum mngar gsum gyi gtor ma oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs pa/ oṃ pakṣiṃ swā hā/ i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pas dbul ba sogs byed do// khyung khra'i sku bris pa lus la bcangs na gso nyes pa sogs kyi nyes skyon thams cad thub/ sa dgra gang yod la zhal bstan pas khang pa'i sa dgra ngan pa thub bo// bong nga za bar 'dod pas bsnyen pa 'bum phrag lnga sngon du song bas lag pa'i mthil du bong nga bzhag ste/ mthe bong nas brtsams pa'i sor mo lnga la sngags lnga bkod pa'i yi ge las ye shes kyi chu rgyun dkar po byung ste/

bong nga la phog pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur par bsams la/ sngags 'di brgya phrag bzlas te che chung nas tsam nas je che la btang nas rtag tu zos na bcud len du 'gyur zhing nad gdon dug rigs kyis mi tshugs par 'gyur ro// khyi smyon la sogs pa'i brtan g.yo'i dug rma gnyan skrangs 'bur la sogs pa rnams la sngags chu khong du btang zhing skrangs pa'i mthar sngags chus bskor la dkyil la dmigs bzhag ste sngags kyi mchil ma btab/ rma byung ma thag tu rang gi dri chus 'khrud cing khong du'ang sngags chu btang*/ lag pa'i sor mo lnga la yi ge lnga bkod cing byabs la nad gdon phyir 'thon par bsam/ lus kyi stod na na bya khyung gis stod nas za bar bsgom/ smad na na rkang pa nas za bar bsgoms la/ sngags bzla zhing nad pa'i gdon gang yin na'ang*/ mgrin pa'i nang gi khyung lnga las sprul pa yang sprul nying sprul gyi bya khyung che ba ri rab tsam/ chung ba rdul phran tsam dpag tu med pa spros/ spyi bo'i gtsug nas rkang mthil yan gyi phyi nang sha rus pags pa rtsa rnams kyi nad gdon thams cad gtubs zos tshar bcad/ lus kyi stod smad khol bur gnyan la sogs kyis na na/ phyi'i khyung gis gang na sar mchus phug ste/ nad gdon gang yin rnams phyir bton nas bskyur zhing 'thon pa'i dmigs pa bya/ zhal du zos nas mid pas mgrin pa'i nang gi khyung gis zos tshar/ slar mi 'jug pa la sogs kyi dmigs pa gsal bar bya'o// yang srung skud 'dogs na skud pa kha dog lnga la mdud pa lnga byas nas spyi dang mthun pa'i srung skud gdags so// yang 'di'i sgo nas sman la bsten nas mdze nad dang*/ 'go nad/ gnyan nad/ rlung nad/ srin nad/ gdon grib la sogs pa gso ba dang bsrung bar 'dod pas/ ril bu'i sbyor sde byed na/ rgyal po khyung lnga/ blon po gros byed lnga/ 'khor go cha can lnga/ 'bangs mtshon thogs lnga rnams bsags te/ de yang rgyal po lnga ni/

a ru ra/ ru rta/ shu dag nag po/ gla rtsi/ sman chen dang lnga'o// blon po gros byed lnga ni/ sha chen/ chos sman/ dri chen/ gi'u wang*/ li shi lnga'o// 'khor lnga ni/ ma nu/ byi tang ka chu rtsa/ gur gum/ cu gang ngo*// 'bangs lnga ni/ stag sha thar nu/ sdig srin/ gu gul/ shing kun lnga yin no// thun tshad ni/ sman chen dang bzhi 'gyur gyi a ru ra/ ru rta a ru ra dang mnyam/ shu dag a ru ra yi phyed/ gla rtsi dri thon tsam/ sha chen dri chen a ru ra dang mnyam/ chos sman/ gi'u wang*/ li shi gsum ci 'dzom/ ma nu a ru ra'i phyed/ byi tang ka ma nu'i phyed/ chu rtsa dang sman chen mnyam/ thams cad ma 'dzom na/ khyung lnga'i steng du sha chen/ gu gul/ gi'u wang*/ dri chen rnams gang rnyed gtang*/ thams cad 'dzom na 'di ga bzhin bya'o// gur gum/ cu gang ci 'dzom/ stag sha a ru ra'i phyed/ thar nu/ sdig srin sman chen dang mnyam/ gu gul/ shing kun ci rigs pa'o// de rnams so sor zhib par btags/ btags zin pa dang*/ lhan cig bsres te/ yang btags te/ dge slong tshul khrims rnam dag gam byis pa lo brgyad lon pa'i dri chus sbrus la/ ril bu bra ba'i ril ma tsam bya/ kha dog mtshal lam sindhū ras bsgyur la/ de 'khar gzhong lnga'i nang du tshan pa lngar spungs nas rang gi mdun du bzhag la/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bdag bskyed byas la/ de rnams kyi steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du khroṃ re bsgoms pa ni/ dbus sngo/ shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang gur bsams la/ khroṃ zhu ba las dbus su hūm̐/ de las khyung sngon po g.yas rdo rje dang*/ g.yon sbrul sngon po bzung nas za ba/ shar du khyung dkar po g.yas 'khor lo dang*/ g.yon sbrul dkar po/ lhor khyung ser po g.yas rin po che dang g.yon sbrul ser po/ nub tu khyung dmar po g.yas padma dang g.yon sbrul dmar po/ byang du khyung ljang gu g.yas ral gri dang g.yon sbrul ljang gu bzung nas za ba re bsgom/

de rnams kyi thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang rang gi kha dog dang mthun pa'i khroṃ re re bsams la/ 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes kyi khyung rigs lnga spyan drangs la yid kyis mchod cing bstims la/ khyung la dmigs pa gsal bar gtad de/ sngags snga ma'i gsham la/ oṃ rā tsa ma hā ga ru ḍa hūm̐ hūm̐ badzra pā ṇi gu hya ga ru ḍa hūm̐ phaṭa/ hur hur bhyo/ hur hur bhyo/ zhes sman gyi phung po re re la stong phrag re bzlas la/ mthar khyung rnams ril bu la bstims la/ ril bu rnams rnam pa ril bu la ngo bo khyung nus pa can thogs med yin par bsgom zhing rten 'brel snying pos rab gnas bya/ bkra shis brjod/ smon lam gdab/ 'di'i phan yon ni rgyun du ril bu re lto stong la brten na klu nad khyi nad gnyan sogs thub/ gnyan byung ma khad gso dgos par gsungs/ rlung dang srin gyi rigs thams cad dang 'go ba'i nad rigs thams cad kun thub/ nyams grib dang gdon gyis mi tshugs/ gnyan la sogs pa la gtong ba'i tshad ni/ bu chung la gsum/ byis pa la lnga/ bud med la bdun/ skyes dar ma la dgu btang*/ 'on kyang sman lto che chung dang dpag par bya'o// lan gcig gis ma thub na lan gnyis bskyar bas thub nges so// shin tu zab pas snod min la gsang ngo*// ye shes khyung khra 'di'i lag len mang yang rtsa ba'i khyung tsam las 'di lta bu'i dmigs pa dang rdzas dang cha lag tshang ba shin tu dkon pas gsang bar bya'o// sa skya pa'i gser chos bcu gsum gyi ya gyal gcig pu gdung brgyud kyi phyag dpe la zhal bshus zer ba 'dug/ ༈ /bstod pa ni/ hūm̐ sa yi rang bzhin rnam dag pas// gti mug las byung dug rnams 'joms// chos dbyings ye shes ngo bo nyid// bde gshegs mkha' lding phyag 'tshal bstod// rigs 'gre/ chu yi rang bzhin= zhe sdang las byung= me long ye shes= rdo rje mkha' lding= nam mkha'i rang bzhin= ser sna las byung=

mnyam nyid ye shes= rin chen mkha' lding= me'i rang bzhin= 'dod chags las byung= sor rtog ye shes= padma mkha' lding= rlung gi rang bzhin= phrag dog las byung= bya grub ye shes= las kyi mkha' lding= brtan dang g.yo ba'i dug rnams kun// me dang chu bzhin 'joms mdzad pa// rigs lnga ye shes lnga yi dngos// mkha' lding khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// 'byung ba'i rang bzhin 'gro rnams kyi// rten g.yo'i dug rnams rab zhi nas// dug rnams ye shes mngon gyur te// rigs lnga'i go 'phang thob par shog /rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'o// ༈ /yang 'di nyid kyi sgo nas bzlas lung ster ba ni/ sa gzhi gtsang zhing 'gol sar rten yod na bkram/ mchod gtor bsham zhing med kyang rung ste/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ bskyed rim bzlas brjod la sogs pa bya/ spro na mdun bskyed la mchod gtor dang bcas pa dbul/ gsol ba btab ste/ slob ma rnams khrus byas stan la 'dug nas maṇḍal phul/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// ces sogs dang*/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po sogs kyis gsol ba gdab/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs rgyun bshags lan gsum rjes zlos byed/ de'i ngang las slob ma rnams rdo rje mkha' lding mgrin pa'i nang gi rigs lnga'i khyung snying ga'i yi ge dang bcas pa gsal bar bskyed/ slob dpon gyi mgrin pa'i nang gi khyung thugs ka'i yi ge dang bcas pa las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros/ bla ma yi dam rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams kyi nus mthu yon tan gyi tshogs ji snyed yod pa thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par spyan drangs/ slob ma rnams kyi mgrin pa dang snying gar thim/ bla ma'i mgrin pa'i khyung yig 'bru dang bcas pa las mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi tshul du slob ma'i mgrin pa'i nang gi khyung thugs ka'i yi ge dang bcas pa la so sor thim pas/ sngar bas kyang rnam pa gsal ba/

rnam dag dran pa/ nga rgyal brtan pa'i mthu stobs yon tan phun sum tshogs pa'i skur gyur par bsams la/ slob dpon gyis sngags bzlas pa'i rjes zlos byed du gzhug yi dam du bzung ba dang dam bca' len 'dod na'ang*/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas/ dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid 'tsho ba'i bar du/ rdo rje nam mkha' lding yi dam du bzung zhing sngags grangs 'di tsam du bzla bar dam bca'/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyis// bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes pa'i rjes zlos dang*/ slob dpon gyis me tog tshom bu slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag la/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyis// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// zhes brjod/ bka' drin gyi maṇḍal phul/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa// de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi// zhes brjod/ de nas slob dpon gyis mdun bskyed kyi gtor mgron la mchod cing bstod la/ gsol btab byas la rten la bstim/ med na gshegs/ dam tshig pa bsdu/ bsngo ba smon lam sogs ji ltar 'os par bya/ de ltar bcom ldan 'das rdo rje nam mkha' lding ye shes khyung khra'i bsnyen sgrub man ngag las tshogs thor bu rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa 'di nyid/ sems can la phan pa kho nas kun nas bslangs te/ rje btsun nā ro pa'i gdams pa mal lo tsā ba nas brgyud pa de dag gi man ngag bla ma sa skya pa chen po nas brgyud pa bzhin bris so// ༈ /rje btsun sa skya pa'i gser chos rdo rje khyung khra'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa bzhugs so// na mo gu ru badzra ga ru ḍā ya/ gang gi mtshan tsam dran pas kyang*// brtan g.yo'i dug rnams 'joms mdzad pa// bla ma rdo rje khyung khra la// btud nas de yi rjes gnang bri// 'dir dpal ldan sa skya pa'i gser chos rdo rje khyung khra'i rjes gnang bya tshul ni/ yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su stegs mtho bar/

rten khebs sogs gzhi bzang pos bkab pa'i steng du maṇḍal sna tshogs padma 'dab brgyad kyi dbus su 'bras kyi tshom bu bkod/ de'i g.yas su gtor ma sum gnyis dpal gyi rnam pa/ smad sum cha zlum po theb klu pad 'dab kyi rnam pa bzhis bskor bar mar khus byugs shing*/ mar gyi rgyan kyis mdzes par spras pa la tsaka li yod na btsugs/ dar sngo ljang gang rung gi gur phug de dag gi mdun tu chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga bsham/ rang gi mdun tu rdor dril me tog gi snod sogs mthong brgyud ltar nyer bsdogs bya/ de nas mchod pa rnams/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ swa bhā bas sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra pā dyaṃ āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ puṣpe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gandhe/ nai wi dya shabda āḥhūm̐/ oṃ dharma ra ṇi sogs brjod pas byin dbab/ skyabs yul gsal btab ste/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la= dam pa'i chos rnams la= 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes ci nus dang*/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du rdo rje khyung khra bsgom par bgyi'o// lan gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang zhes sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang*/

ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du phuḥyongs su gyur pa las klu chen po brgyad kyi ngo bo sbrul sna tshogs kyi gdengs ka dang bcas pa'i steng du khroṃ kha dog lnga'i mdangs dang ldan pa zhig tu gyur/ de las 'od zer 'phros sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid ye shes kyi khyung khra zhal gcig phyag gnyis tsog pu 'gying bag dang ldan pas bzhugs pa'i brla gnyis man chad sa'i rang bzhin ser po/ lte ba chu'i rang bzhin dkar po/ stod me'i rang bzhin dmar po/ mgo bo rlung gi rang bzhin sngon po/ spyi bo dang 'dab gshog nam mkha'i rang bzhin kha dog sna tshogs pa/ rwa dang mchu sder rno ba/ dmar la 'khrugs pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas pas klu'i rgyal po'i gtsug nas yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che 'phrogs te rwa g.yas pa'i nam mkhar bzhag nas sgrub pa po la dngos grub ster zhing skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ phyag g.yon pas gdug pa can tshar gcod cing sreg par byed pa'i sdigs mdzub thugs kar 'dzin pa rin po che dang sbrul gyis brgyan zhing*/ sku tshad ri rab lta bu'i ba spu'i bu ga nas 'od zer 'phro ba/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par bsgom/ de'i mgrin pa'i nang du pad zla'i gdan gyi steng du dbus su sangs rgyas kyi khyung dkar po/ shar du rdo rje'i khyung sngon po/ lhor rin chen khyung ser po/ nub tu padma'i khyung dmar po/ byang du las kyi khyung ljang gu/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas pa rnams kyis 'khor lo/ rdo rje/ rin po che/ padma/ ral gri rnams nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing g.yon pas rang mdog dang mthun pa'i sbrul bzung nas zhal du gsol zhing sdigs mdzub thugs kar mdzad nas zhal nang du phyogs nas bzhugs pa/ gtso bo'i thugs kar pad zla'i steng du oṃ dkar po/ shar du paṃ sngon po/ lhor kṣiṃ ser po/

nub tu swā dmar po/ byang du hā ljang gu rnams chos skor du bzhengs pa/ khyung gtso bo dang mgrin pa'i khyung lnga'i gnas gsum du oṃ āḥhūm̐ bkod pa las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas ye shes pa ga ru ḍa sa pa ri wā ra badzra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drang*/ oṃ arghaṃ nas shabda'i bar gyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs gnyis su med par bstim/ bskyed rim brtan pa'i ngang nas bzlas pa bya ste/ oṃ pakṣiṃ swā hā/ zhes ci nus bzla/ thun 'jog khar mchod pa rnam lngas mchod/ bstod pa 'og nas 'byung bas bstod/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ klu dang sa bdag gi gnod pa thams cad zhi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes gsol ba btab/ dge ba bsngo/ gal te bdag bskyed rkyang pa byed na skyabs 'gro nas 'di'i bar byas pas don 'grub bo// mdun bskyed ni/ tshom bu bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las zhes pa nas gnyis su med par thim gyi bar gong gi bdag bskyed kyi skabs bzhin la rang nyid ces pa dor ba ma gtogs 'dra'o// de nas mchod pa kha gsos/ bsang sbyang byin rlabs gong ltar las/ badzra ga ru ḍa sa pa ri wā ra re re mgor sbyar ba'i arghaṃ nas shabda'i bar gyis mchod/ 'byung lnga'i rang bzhin 'byung chen lnga la dbang*// kun tu sgyur byed rdo rje'i 'dab gshog can/ klu yi dpal 'phrog lha mi'i dpal gyur pa// rdo rje nam mkha' lding la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bstod/ gtor ma bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che bar gtor ma ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlab/ oṃ pakṣiṃ swā hā/ i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes lan gsum gyis phul/ sngar bzhin mchod bstod bya/ mdun bskyed la dmigs pa'i bzlas pa cung zad bya/

de nas slob ma rnams bos khrus dang phyag byas gral la 'khod pa la/ me tog bkye bsdu grub nas/ 'o nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du rjes su gnang ba gsan la don nyams su bzhes snyam pa bsam pa byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa gsal btab nas gsan 'tshal/ de la gsan par bya ba'i chos ni 'dir skabs su bab pa dpal dus kyi 'khor lo nas bshad pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i lha gsum gyi nang nas brtan g.yo'i dug zhi bar byed pa'i mkha' lding rdo rje khyung khra dpal sa skya pa'i gser chos kyi nang tshan du gyur pa de nyid kyi rjes su gnang ba sgrub par byed pa la/ slob dpon gyis bgyi bar 'os pa thams cad nye bar grub nas khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa slob ma'i bya ba la/ thog mar slob dpon dang rdo rje khyung khra tha mi dad pa la rjes su gnang ba zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal 'bul bar zhu/ zhes 'bul du gzhug de ltar maṇḍal phul nas snyims pa me tog dang bcas thal mo sbyar nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can// srid pa'i 'khor lo rnam sbyong ba// de ring bshad pa'i rin chen gter// gtso bos bdag la bka' drin stsol// khyed zhabs padmo spangs nas ni// gtso bo gzhan la skyabs ma mchis// 'gro ba'i dpa' bo mthu chen gyis// blo mchog bdag la'ang gnang bar mdzod// lan gsum/ rgyud dag pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang rdo rje khyung khra tha mi dad pa la yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs sangs rgyas byang sems kyis bskor ba mngon sum lta bur bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar yan lag bdun pa bgyid snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs/ slar yang thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag la mkha' lding rdo rje khyung khra'i rjes su gnang ba ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes pa rnams sngon 'gro yin/ dngos gzhi sku'i rjes gnang gi slad du slob dpon la rdo rje khyung khra dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus byas pa'i rkyen gyis slob dpon gyis thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed la phog gnyis ka'i thugs ka nas 'od zer nyi ma shar ba lta bu 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus la phog pas tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib sbyangs nas lus 'od kyi phung por gyur pa de nyid la dmigs te/ oṃ swa bhā ba nas haṃ zhes pas snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis mi dmigs pa'i stong nyid 'od gsal nam mkha' lta bur gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ stong pa'i ngang las zhes pa nas chos skor du zhes pa'i bar bdag bskyed las rang nyid ces pa'i tshab tu khyed rang rnams zhes brjod/ slar yang slob dpon bdun bskyed dang bcas pa'i thugs ka nas 'od zer bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul bas/ de dag gi thugs ka dang*/ khyad par mkha' spyod kyi gnas nas rdo rje khyung khra'i lha tshogs sku che ba ri rab tsam/ bar pa mi tshad tsam/ chung ba rdul phran tsam bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs/ khyed rang rnams lhar gsal ba'i spyi bo'i gtsug dbang po'i sgo/ ba spu'i bu ga nas rdo tshan la kha ba bab pa bzhin du sib sib thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod la gu gul gyis bdug rol mo bya zhing rtsa sngags kyi mthar ā be sha ya aḥ.āḥ zhes yang yang brjod/ des rdo rje khyung khra'i sku'i rjes su gnang ba thob/ lus kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad klu dang sa bdag gi gnod pa thams cad zhi bar byas nas rdo rje khyung gi sku dang nus pa mnyam par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/

rjes su bzlas pa'i lung gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon la mos gus byas pas slob dpon gyi mgrin pa'i nang gi khyung thugs ka'i yi ge dang bcas pa las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros/ bla ma yi dam rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i nus pa mthu stobs yon tan gyi tshogs ji snyed yod pa thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par spyan drangs/ khyed rang rnams kyi mgrin pa dang snying gar thim/ yang slob dpon gyi mgrin pa'i khyung thugs ka'i yig 'bru dang bcas pa las de 'dra ba gnyis pa re re mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi tshul du byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi mgrin pa'i nang gi khyung thugs ka'i yi ge dang bcas pa la so sor thim pas/ sngar bas kyang rnam pa gsal ba/ rnam dag dran pa/ nga rgyal brtan pa'i mthu stobs yon tan phun sum tshogs pa'i skur gyur par mos nas sngags 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ pakṣiṃ swā hā/ zhes brgya rtsa brgyad kyi rjes zlos bya/ de ltar bzlas pas dang pos rgyud byin gyis brlabs/ gnyis pas dbyer med du byas/ gsum pa man chad kyis brtan par mos pas drin lan du me tog gtor bas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyis// bcom ldan 'di la 'go bar mdzod// lan gsum/ slob dpon gyi khyed rang rnams kyis phul ba'i me tog gi phreng ba sngags kyi phreng bar byin gyis brlabs nas phul ba'i mos pa mdzod/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyis// bcom ldan 'di la 'go bar mdzod// bcom ldan 'das kyi byin rlabs ni// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol// rig pa 'dzin pa 'di rnams kyi rgyud la rdo rje khyung khra'i gsang sngags kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa 'jug par gyur cig yi dam du 'dzin pa dang dam bca' ba'i slad du dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du rdo rje khyud khra yi dam du bzung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/

slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas/ dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du mkha' lding rdo rje khyung khra yi dam gyi lhar bzung bar bgyi'o// des rdo rje khyung khra'i gsung gi rjes su gnang ba thob/ ngag gi sgo nas bsags pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad klu dang sa bdag gi gnod pa zhi bar byas/ rdo rje khyung khra'i gsung dang nus pa mnyam par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ byin gyis brlab pa'i lung ngam/ thugs kyi rjes gnang gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon la mos gus byas pa'i rkyen gyis thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed la phog pas mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas rdo rje khyung gi sku theb sor gyi tshad tsam rgyang gis bye nas byon pa/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar thim pa de nyid la dmigs pa gtad pas gdan 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur nas rang la thim/ rang nyid thugs ka'i sa bon la thim/ de yang nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar yal bas rang bzhin gnyis snang gis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis ma dmigs pa'i stong nyid 'od gsal nam mkha' lta bu bde stong dbyer med kyi de bzhin nyid rgyud la skyes par mos nas/ de'i ngang la cung zad mnyam par 'jog par zhu/ des rdo rje khyung khra'i thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba thob/ sems kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad klu dang sa bdag gi gnod pa thams cad zhi bar byas/ rdo rje khyung khra'i thugs dang nus pa mnyam par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas spro na gtor ma'i bka' bsgo ba yang spyi ltar bya'o// skabs 'dir sgom lung gi dmigs pa phog des rjes gnang gi dngos gzhi grub nas gnas skabs de dag tu khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa tshul bzhin tu 'dzin par bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bo sogs/ rjes gnang dang sgom lung thob pa'i gtang rag tu maṇḍal 'bul bar zhu/

zhes phul/ maṇḍal du ma zad lus longs spyod thams cad kyang 'bul na/ cha shas nas longs spyad du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ deng nas sogs bya/ des zab pa las kyang ches zab pa rdo rje khyung khra'i rjes gnang sgom lung dang bcas pa thob pas rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po mdzad par zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs brjod/ slob ma rnams btang*/ rjes la mchod pa rnams kha gsos/ bsang sbyang byin gyis brlab/ mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ sngar bzhin bstod/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ yig brgya lan gsum/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ tsaka li yod na brtan bzhugs/ badzra muḥtshom bu'i ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/ dge ba bsngo zhing bkra shis rgyas par bya'o// de ltar klu gnyan sa bdag kun gyi gshed// mkha' lding rdo rje khyung gi sgrub pa'i thabs// rjes gnang dang bcas go bde bklag chog tu// bkod dges brtan g.yo'i dug kun zhi gyur cig /ces pa mkha' lding rdo rje khyung khra'i rjes gnang bya tshul go bde bklag chog tu bkod pa bklags pas don grub ces bya ba 'di yang rje bla ma mkhyen rab mtshan can gyi zhabs drung du gdams pa 'di lan du ma'i bar du thob pa'i gsung rgyun phyag bzhes nyams pa med pa rnams brjod par phangs te zhabs rdul ring du brten cing sku drin kho nas 'tsho ba'i bya bral ba lhun grub kyis rang gi dran pa gso ba dang skal ba mnyam pa dag la phan pa'i bsam pas bris pa 'dis kyang sems can thams cad klu dang sa bdag gi 'jigs pa las thar bar gyur cig/ ༈ /rkyen sel lta bur gtor ma'i bka' bsgo byed par 'dod na/ thugs kyi rjes gnang gi mjug tu/ gtor ma 'di nyid ye shes rdo rje khyung khrar gsal ba'i steng gi nam mkhar rtsa brgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/

yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams mngon sum du bzhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ rdo rje 'chang*/ chos rgyal zla ba bzang po/ 'jam dpal grags pa/ padma dkar po/ dus zhabs pa che chung gnyis/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ pham mthing pa sku mched/ mal lo tsā ba blo gros grags pa/ rje btsun brtse ba chen po/ slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs sa skya paṇḍi ta/ chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ rgyal ba brag phug pa/ ri khrod pa blo gros brtan pa/ chos rje dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang*/ gu ge paṇa chen grags pa rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub/ rgyal ba lha mchog seng ge/ rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas seng ge/ paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ khri chen kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rmor chen kun dga' lhun grub/ gnas gsar ba kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ 'jam mgon kun dga' blo gros/ byams pa nam mkha' 'chi med/ bdag gi drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin bkra shis grags pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la sogs pa'i rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ dpal ye shes kyi rdo rje khyung khra'i lha tshogs rnams kyis rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum gyi bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang*/ mthun rkyen tshe dang bsod nams rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ mdor na mchog thun mong gi dngos grub thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes dang*/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs kyis byin rlabs shing*// dngos grub rnam gnyis 'byung ba'i gnas// gtor ma'i dbang bskur sbyin par bya// oṃ pakṣiṃ swā hā/

mthar gtor ma dpal rdo rje khyung khrar gsal ba de nyid khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par mos pa mdzod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod/ maṅga laṃ bha ba tu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
